difficulty_reason: The authors translate recursive programs into least-fixed-point trace formulas and synthesize canonical nondeterministic programs in the opposite direction, proving semantic preservation using recursion/valuation correspondence and stuttering equivalence. These two constructive translations require non-routine fixed-point arguments and are grouped as one expressivity theorem.
core_obligations: Retain both translation definitions and the precise stuttering relation.
Retain the full procedure-interpretation/recursion-variable correspondence and canonical-program induction.
Do not count the Galois consequence separately.
